headline: Two sealed readings spent today, both lost — and the second one taught us why. The edge we staked it on has a median of +2% and a year-to-year spread of 0.76x to 1.52x. It was a coin flip we had not bothered to price. The champion holds at +25.71%.
target: Sealed 2026 is the exam · beat +25.71% · minimum +30%/year · every year positive

gpu_job.title: v4 — the decision tree searched on top of the reference net (5 workers)
gpu_job.exam: 2024-2025 held out from BOTH the net and the thresholds — the first genuinely clean joint search here

steps.title: Audit the whole training path, by probe not by reading
steps.detail: 10 seams measured: features causal bit-for-bit, execution structurally honest; 2 faults found and queued

steps.title: Deep-field net — sees 127 of its 96 bars (champion sees 15)
steps.detail: won EVERY research metric, then lost the exam: sealed 2026 −18.04% vs champion +25.71% — memorisation, not skill

steps.title: Walk-forward instrument: train ≤2024, exam on 2025 alone
steps.detail: VALIDATED — it agrees with the sealed year (deep net: −25.84% vs control −6.54%, same trade-inflation signature). Now the standing gate for every model change

steps.title: Ensemble of 5 seed-varied nets, champion architecture, walk-forward
steps.detail: WON the exam: unseen 2025 +6.46% (DD 16.4%, 45 trades) vs single seed −6.54% (DD 21.9%, 72 trades) — first candidate ever to win a walk-forward A/B

steps.title: Ensemble second exam — train ≤2023, examine 2024
steps.detail: single won: unseen 2024 +22.36% vs ensemble +16.95%. 1-of-2 → no sealed reading. But the pair shows the ensemble trims BOTH tails: positive in both exam years (single lost one), compounded +24.5% vs +14.4%

steps.title: Ensemble third exam — train ≤2022, examine 2023
steps.detail: ensemble LOSES the series. 2023: single +2.91% vs ensemble −26.25%. Mandate lens over 3 exams: both 2/3 years positive, tiebreak mean min(ret,30%) single +0.0624 vs ensemble −0.0095. The 2025 win was the draw — the 2-of-2 rule saved a sealed reading

steps.title: Joint threshold search — Bayesian TPE over all 33 levers
steps.detail: CLOSED at 1,668 combinations (1,602 distinct). Only 1% beat the champion on the fitted years; the best of them GAINS +0.0160 on fit and LOSES −0.0154 out of sample. Verdict: the champion's thresholds already sit at a generalising optimum

steps.title: Recency-weighted training — the market evolves, weight recent years
steps.detail: WON exam 1 on unseen 2025: half-life 2y +1.16% (DD 15.6%) vs no-decay control −6.54% (DD 21.9%). Half-life 4y −6.30% ≈ control, so the response is ORDERED with the lever — and the win came with LOWER drawdown, not more risk

steps.title: Recency exam 2 — confirm half-life 2y on unseen 2024
steps.detail: CONFIRMATION FAILS. Unseen 2024: half-life 2y −7.76% at 32.9% drawdown vs the +22.36% control at 17.9%. 1-of-2, so exam 1's win was the draw — same shape as the ensemble. No sealed reading. The exploratory 1y arm beat the control (+24.92%) but adopts nothing: it starts its own series

steps.title: Shorter receptive fields — if 15 bars beats 127, where is the optimum?
steps.detail: the champion's reach was never chosen; measure below it

steps.title: Macro channel: Fed, CPI, payrolls, oil — sizing/veto, point-in-time
steps.detail: exogenous risk trigger — the operator's ‘smaller trades when the world is tense’

steps.title: Reference markets as inputs: DXY, gold, NASDAQ, VIX, rates
steps.detail: WON exam 1 on unseen 2025 — and halved the drawdown. Control (44 columns) −6.54% at 21.9% DD; +8 reference columns +0.98% at 11.8% DD; with recency 2y +20.44% at 11.5% DD. Identical training data, only the columns differ

steps.title: Reference features — second exam on unseen 2024
steps.detail: CONFIRMATION FAILS. Unseen 2024: reference net −16.67% at 33.6% DD (and −16.37% with recency) against the +22.36% control at 17.9%. 1-of-2, so exam 1's win was the draw — the fourth candidate this rule has stopped before it cost a sealed reading

steps.title: v4 — the 32-lever tree searched ON the reference net, not the champion's
steps.detail: the one thing A96b could not rule out: that net was judged under thresholds tuned for a DIFFERENT net, which measures the pair badly. Net trained ≤2023, thresholds fitted 2018-2023, 2024-2025 held out from both. 5 workers, 4,000 trials

steps.title: Trivial baselines — does any of this beat a moving average?
steps.detail: IT DOES, and it refutes the over-complication hypothesis. Same 15bp toll on every arm. SEALED 2026: champion +25.71% vs BTC −10.33%, basket −1.92%, SMA200-BTC +12.44%, SMA200-basket −0.75%. 2018: +178.68% while BTC lost 72.77%. Beats the basket 6/9 years and the SMA200 basket 9/9. Where it loses is straight-line bull years — the trend-follower's bargain

steps.title: Module ablation — which of the nine active levers earns its place?
steps.detail: FOUR OF NINE ARE NOT EARNING IT. The 16-bar minimum hold is a COST — removing it improved EVERY year (fit +0.3143 vs +0.2760, held-out +0.1738 vs +0.1572, worst fit year +8.68% → +29.81%) at slightly LOWER drawdown. The trailing stop and the breadth gate carry nothing; Fear & Greed moves nothing at all. Meta-labelling and the trend veto are genuinely load-bearing (without meta, 2025 goes to −31.4% and the drawdown doubles). Two arms were INVALID — max_drawdown=0.0 is the tightest brake, not the absent one — and are repaired in A120

steps.title: min_hold response curve + the lean champion + A119's two repaired arms
steps.detail: CURVE PERFECTLY ORDERED — 0 inversions of 7 steps, fit falling 0.3143 → 0.0465 as min_hold goes 1 → 48. The lean champion beat the incumbent on all six fitted years, both held-out years, worst fitted year +32.85% vs +8.68%, drawdown 11.9% vs 19.1%. It earned its reading under a rule written before the numbers. Also settled: the whole risk layer removed destroys the held-out half (−0.1011), so it is not ceremony; and the 50% circuit breaker has never fired on this record

steps.title: The lean champion's one sealed 2026 reading — SPENT AND LOST
steps.detail: 2026: lean −11.65% at 21.8% DD on 215 trades, against the control +25.71% at 22.1% DD on 90 trades — the control reproduced to the decimal through the same path, so this is the candidate, not a wiring fault. A 37-point loss from a candidate that had won every research year AND both held-out years. The strongest instrument this project has does not predict the sealed year

steps.title: Is min_hold an edge, or leverage on a net that memorised the year?
steps.detail: MEMORISATION — registered prediction, confirmed. On _wf23_ref (trained ≤2023) min_hold=1 pays a median 1.88x on 2018-2023 and 0.85x on 2024-2025, and its 2024 ratio is 0.70x, the SAME number the champion net gave for 2026. Unseen score −0.4033 vs the baseline's −0.1417. And the curve INVERTS: on unseen years min_hold 48 scored +0.0059 and 24 scored −0.0097 against 16's −0.1417 — longer was better, the opposite of what every study here has said

steps.title: Cross-asset corpus: equities, FX, gold — more independent episodes
steps.detail: crypto is one risk factor sampled 27 times; independence is the scarce input

steps.title: The same calendar year, seen by one net and unseen by another
steps.detail: MEMORISATION REFUTED — with the calendar year held fixed and only the net's memory changing, the gap vanishes: 2024 pays 0.86x seen and 0.81x unseen; 2023 pays 1.09x seen and 0.91x unseen. A121's step was the year composition of its blocks. What survives is a REGIME CHANGE: fast rotation paid 2.97x in 2018 and 4.17x in 2021, then 1.12x in 2022 and 0.82x in 2024. And the consequence replicates 3/3 — on the years each net never saw, a longer hold beats the champion's 16 (64 at +0.1707 vs +0.0885; 32 at +0.2077 vs +0.1064; 128 at +0.0066 vs −0.0429)

steps.title: Longer hold: four more boundaries, deliberately chosen to be unalike
steps.detail: REPLICATED 7 of 8 — on the years each net never saw, some hold longer than 16 beats it on seven of eight walk-forward boundaries. But the setting was decided by a whisker: 32 and 64 both win 7/8 with median margins +0.0834 and +0.0805. A plateau from 32 to 64, not a peak

steps.title: Complete the grid so the VOTE decides, not the dict order
steps.detail: the five empty cells filled; 32 and 64 both win 7 of 8 and the registered tie-break (votes, then median margin, then closest to 16) resolved for 32 by +0.0029. Honest reading: 32-64 is a plateau

steps.title: min_hold 32 — one lever, one sealed reading, SPENT AND LOST
steps.detail: 2026: +22.38% at 20.34% DD on 73 trades against the control's +25.71% at 22.13% on 90. Three points of return given up for 1.8 points of drawdown. The prediction registered before the run was that a longer hold WINS. It did not. min_hold closes under its own rule and the champion keeps 16 bars

steps.title: Was the instrument broken, or read at odds nobody computed?
steps.detail: UNDERPOWERED, NOT REFUTED. Distance from the training cutoff explains nothing — longer holds beat 16 at +1 year too. But per YEAR at the matched distance the 32-bar ratio runs 0.76x to 1.52x, median 1.02x, winning 71% of years, and the sealed draw of 0.97x sits inside that range, below two of seven. Eight 'boundaries' were read as eight verdicts when they are seven noisy year-observations. New protocol rule: never spend a sealed reading on an edge whose year-to-year spread straddles 1.0

verdicts.text: THE REAL LESSON OF A LOSING DAY — we spent two sealed readings on edges we never priced. The second one, min_hold 32, has a median advantage of +2% and a spread from 0.76x to 1.52x across years: it wins about seven years in ten, and 2026 was one of the three. That is not a broken instrument, it is an unpowered test. From now on a sealed reading requires an edge whose year-to-year spread does not straddle 1.0

min_hold 32 SEALED AND LOST: +22.38% at 20.34% drawdown against the champion's +25.71% at 22.13%. The pre-registered prediction was that a longer hold wins; it did not, so min_hold closes and the champion keeps its 16 bars. What it bought was 1.8 points of drawdown for 3.3 of return — roughly proportional, which the BALANCE criterion calls no improvement

I WAS WRONG ABOUT MEMORISATION, and A122 refuted it with the same rigour it was proposed with. The real finding is a regime change: fast rotation paid 2.97x in 2018 and pays nothing after 2022. The champion's 16-bar hold was fitted on a record four-fifths of which predates the change, and on every year no net has seen — three walk-forward boundaries, a fourth from A121, and the sealed 2026 itself — holding LONGER wins

THE SEALED LOSS IS EXPLAINED. min_hold is leverage on the net's memory: on _wf23_ref it pays 1.88x on years that net trained on and 0.85x on the two it never saw — its 2024 ratio is 0.70x, identical to the champion net's 2026. Two independent nets, same signature. The consequence is large: no threshold study here has ever measured a reactivity lever on years its net had not memorised

AND THE CURVE INVERTS — on years the net never saw, LONGER holds beat shorter ones (48 bars +0.0059, 24 bars −0.0097, the champion's 16 −0.1417, 1 bar −0.4033). Every study this project ran said shorter was better, and every one of them scored on memorised years. If A122 replicates this across three boundaries, the champion's hold is too SHORT

SEALED READING SPENT AND LOST — the lean champion made −11.65% in 2026 against the control's +25.71%, after winning all six fitted years, both held-out years and a perfectly ordered response curve. The champion holds. The finding is not the loss, it is that our best instrument cleared a candidate that then failed by 37 points

THE LIKELY MECHANISM, now being tested: min_hold is not an edge, it is leverage on the net's accuracy. Its payoff per year runs 3.16x (2018) → 1.05x (2025) → 0.70x (2026), monotone in how long the net trained on that year, and the only year it LOSES is the only year the net never saw. If A121 confirms it on a net trained ≤2023, then every threshold study this project has run scored its candidates on the net's own training years

WHY THE SEARCH KEPT SAYING THE CHAMPION WAS OPTIMAL — it never tested one lever at a time. Of 1,607 v3 trials, the closest to 'the champion with min_hold at 1' differed in 24 of the other 31 levers. A joint TPE measures the joint space; single-lever effects are invisible inside it. The first one-at-a-time ablation found a lever that improves EVERY year of the record

FOUR OF THE CHAMPION'S NINE LEVERS ARE NOT EARNING THEIR PLACE. Removing the 16-bar minimum hold improves every year (worst fit year +8.68% → +29.81%, held-out +0.1738 vs +0.1572) at lower drawdown; the trailing stop, the breadth gate and the Fear & Greed veto carry nothing. Meta-labelling and the trend veto are real — without meta, 2025 is −31.4% at double the drawdown. Simpler AND better is on the table for the first time

NOT DISGUISED BETA — the apparatus beats every trivial rule on the sealed year (champion +25.71% vs BTC −10.33%, basket −1.92%, SMA200 +12.44%), made +178.68% in 2018 while BTC lost 72.77%, and its worst year in nine is −2.96%. The over-complication hypothesis was mine and the data refused it

Reference features refused: won unseen 2025 (+0.98% alone, +20.44% with recency, both at ~11.5% DD) and lost unseen 2024 by nearly forty points (−16.67% vs +22.36%). 1-of-2. The remaining doubt — that it was judged under another net's thresholds — is what v4 is now searching

BEST RESULT YET — reference markets (VIX, NASDAQ, dollar, oil, curve) win exam 1 on unseen 2025: +0.98% alone and +20.44% with recency, both at ~11.5% drawdown against the control's −6.54% at 21.9%. Same training data, only 8 new columns. Exam 2 running
Recency weighting refused: won unseen 2025 (+1.16% vs −6.54%) and lost unseen 2024 (−7.76% vs +22.36%). Five routes measured, five refused — the champion holds

FIRST REAL SIGNAL — the operator's own idea: recency-weighted training (half-life 2y) turns unseen 2025 from −6.54% into +1.16% with lower drawdown, and 4y decay reproduces the control, so the response follows the lever. Exam 2 running before anything is claimed
Ensemble retired: won exam 1 (+6.46% vs −6.54%), lost exams 2 and 3 (+16.95 vs +22.36; −26.25 vs +2.91). One exam year is a coin flip — the pre-registered rule saved a sealed reading
Threshold search CLOSED: 1,668 combinations say the champion's values are already at a generalising optimum — the 1% that fit better do not transfer (fit +0.0160, held-out −0.0154)
Second exam: single seed wins raw 2024 (+22.36% vs +16.95%) — no sealed reading. The ensemble was positive in BOTH exam years though; a third exam arbitrates under the mandate lens
